labelled_by: hand-authored for e4.4 (reco-884): the shapes a reviewer said they would stop for, drawn from the e1.12 acceptance fixture and the e4.3 detector catalogue; one reviewer, dispositions written before any weight was set

units.findings: severity-points (high 3, medium 2, low 1); 8 fills the axis
units.surface: the top surface weight from risk::Surface (migration 50, ci/infra 46, dependency 36, source 10, docs 3)
units.migration: exposure 0-1 (a migration file is 0.55, a destructive statement in the added lines is 1.0)
units.blast: dependent paths; 40 fills the axis. Absent here: nothing in this build can measure it
units.test_ratio: coverage share of the additions, 0-1 (the model risks on its complement)
units.size: reviewable lines of churn (the log ruler tops out at 20 000)
units.dependency: exposure 0-1 (a lockfile is 0.55, a manifest 0.35, a supplied direct add 0.8, a major move 1.0)
units.deletions: removal shape 0-1 (three-fifths removal is 0.6, a shrunken test surface floors it at 0.75)
units.noise: share of churn that is generated, locked, vendored or binary, 0-1
units.breadth: spread 0-1 (0.15 per surface past the first, 0.2 past 12 files, 0.4 past 30)
units.attribution: the attribution confidence, 0-1 (the model risks on its complement)
